findings.title: Default router breaks default-model cost fallback
findings.problem: get_model_cost() uses self.default_llm_model both when no base_name is passed and as the fallback for unknown names. default_llm_model can now return a LiteLLM auto-router. If that router entry has no cost, the direct match fails, and _get_router_model_cost only resolves switchyard routers (get_llm_routers / router.switchyard.capable_model). The final fallback then matches the same cost-less router, so the function returns None. Before this change it returned a concrete default model's cost.
findings.impact: Token/cost callbacks (tokens_callback.py:107,437, core/utils.py:523, proxy_router.py:1006) can stop costing usage for unknown or default models whenever a cost-less router is the default. Reachability unconfirmed: it depends on whether LiteLLM router entries carry cost in model_info.
findings.recommendation: For cost fallback, resolve to a concrete priced model when the default is a LiteLLM auto-router. For example, fall back to the first enabled concrete default that has a cost, or resolve the router's tier/classifier model cost. Add a test for get_model_cost(None) and for an unknown name with a cost-less default router.

findings.title: Router-first default diverges from category defaults
findings.problem: default_llm_model now picks an enabled default LiteLLM router before any concrete default. _get_global_default_model and get_default_model_for_category still return the first enabled GLOBAL-default model in catalog order, without that preference.
findings.impact: When a router and a concrete model are both marked GLOBAL default, default_llm_model and get_default_models_by_category/get_default_model_for_category report different global defaults, so different code paths and clients act on different defaults. Reachability unconfirmed: it requires both entries to be flagged default in the catalog.
findings.recommendation: Put the router-first preference in one shared helper and use it in default_llm_model, _get_global_default_model and the GLOBAL fallback of get_default_model_for_category. If both being default is invalid configuration, reject it or log a warning.
